thesis: A useful shared temporal substrate should support ordinary human practice, not only visualizers and games. VOICE tests that claim with local microphone pitch/stability feedback and optional FIELD PULSE timing.
new: local-only microphone pitch estimation over a bounded 70–950 Hz singing range
single-note, 1-3-5-3, five-note and free-hum practice patterns
reference tone without recording or uploading microphone audio
cents relation, clarity and short-window pitch stability witnesses
optional FIELD PULSE consumption from LISTEN/AUDIO or FIELD LAB/SYNTH clocks
pattern steps may follow borrowed beat timing while exercise authorship stays local
bounded practice RETURN exports aggregate evidence only; never raw microphone audio
constraints: VOICE is a consumer of FIELD PULSE timing, never an audio/source authority
no speech recognition, lyric scoring, cloud inference or microphone recording in 0.1
external clock failure never blocks manual practice

verification.human_phone: REQUIRED: one 60-second note hold + one PULSE-linked 1-3-5-3 pass on phone

promotion_gate: A non-technical user can start mic, hear a target, understand flat/center/sharp and complete one pattern without architectural explanation; pulse linkage must feel additive rather than required.
